purpose: Complete the eight-tier Audio2Tool table at one resolution. Tier 1 was decided at n = 500 on 2026-09-04 and tiers 2, 5 and 8 the same day; the four tiers left are the ones the frozen 400 happened to place INSIDE the owner's 3-point band at n = 50 -- tier 3 72.0 against a published 74.7, tier 4 28.0 against 33.4, tier 6 84.0 against 81.5, tier 7 58.0 against 54.6 -- all with a CI90 of about +/-11 pp, which is far too wide to call any of them aligned. This run repeats the official-population recipe unchanged on exactly those tiers: 500 queries per tier from each tier's own released population under the paper code's own loader rule, one roster, one split identity hash, one cell, tier as the stratum. The protocol is untouched -- the request is byte-identical to R-official-raw, T1-official-pop-500 and T258-official-pop-1500. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-04-a2t-tier3467-official-population-v1-preregistration.md.

weakest_published_speechlm.note: the weakest published SpeechLM row on each tier

A2T-TIER3467-OFFICIAL-POP-2000.selection: each tier's released population (the first recording the released loader resolves in every query_* directory; on tier 7 that is sorted(query_dir.glob('turn_*_user_*.wav'))[0], the FIRST user turn), sampled uniformly without replacement, seed 20260803, via random.Random(seed).sample over that tier's population in ascending manifest-id order. max_samples was NOT used: the release orders every subset smart_home -> wearables -> smart_car, so the first 500 sorted directories would be a near-pure smart_home sample on all four tiers.
A2T-TIER3467-OFFICIAL-POP-2000.estimand: per-tier tool accuracy on each tier's own released population, estimated from a uniform 500-query sample per tier

cells.factor: population and n: each tier's own released population at n = 500 instead of 50 stratified mixed-speaker rows
cells.factor_a_output_contract: unchanged from R-official-raw, T1-official-pop-500 and T258-official-pop-1500: the published system message (the adapter's hard-coded default prompt, the fixed '## Available Tools:' header, and format_tools_compact over the whole 152-row registry)
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: -c 49152 -np 2, 24,576 tokens per slot -- the tier-1 official-population geometry, forced by the same release defect. This roster carries THREE 654-second wavs (tier3_multi_intent:003555, tier6_correction:003151, tier7_multiturn:001033), so the worst request needs 3,581 + 8,515 + 256 + 2 = 12,354 tokens; -np 2 leaves 12,222 of margin against the 8,192-token reserve and -np 3 leaves 4,030 and is refused.

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py -- the same harness and the same entry point every calibration, replication and official-population cell flew
shared_protocol.per_cell_dataset_fragment: this run's single cell is launched with --dataset audio2tool-tier3467-official-population-2000; the runner composes model + dataset + baseline + experiment exactly as every earlier Audio2Tool direct cell did

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 2,000 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 2,008; the registered exposure ceiling is 2,080
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 11,964.831167 s for one pass, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires (11,965); the registered exposure ceiling is 12,100
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 1.5. T258-official-pop-1500 flew 1,500 raw rows in 934 s of generation at -np 3 with a longest wav of 32 s; this cell is 2,000 rows at -np 2 and carries three 654-second wavs whose mmproj encode is the only unmodelled cost. The registered ceiling is 2.0
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values

metrics: official tool accuracy (primary gold tool), per tier, with a Wilson CI90 at n = 500
official parameter precision/recall/F1, macro over samples as the published code computes it
parameter F1 micro-pooled, reported beside the macro figure
a2t-toolcall-v2 ordered tool accuracy, exact match and slot F1 under the extended parse
mandatory_slices: per tier: tool accuracy, exact match and parameter F1 with a Wilson CI90 at n = 500, against the paper's row and against the Qwen-2.5-Omni-7B and weakest-published-SpeechLM floors
per tier by domain (smart_home / wearables / smart_car), natural mixture and equal-domain

tier 3 under BOTH the official first-call rule and a2t-toolcall-v2's ordered rule, with the count of rows whose response named more than one call and the count of gold rows carrying additional expected calls
tier 7: which user turn each row resolved to, and how the frozen 400's tier-7 rows were bound for comparison
each tier against the frozen 400's own 50 rows of that tier, so the population effect is a difference rather than a replacement
official scorer versus the extended a2t-toolcall-v2 on the same outputs, per tier, with the rule behind any gap larger than 3 points named
parse rate and the count of rows whose response named more than one call

decision.owner_alignment_standard: 2026-09-04 owner directive: aligned means within 3 points of the official number, and being better than the official number by more than 3 points is also acceptable. The number is a2t-toolcall-official's tool accuracy.

per_tier_rule.aligned: ALIGNED: official tool accuracy >= paper - 3.0 (tier 3 >= 71.7, tier 4 >= 30.4, tier 6 >= 78.5, tier 7 >= 51.6), or better than the paper.
per_tier_rule.consistent_within_noise: CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE: not ALIGNED, but the paper value lies inside the Wilson score CI90 for a binomial proportion at n = 500.

decision.floor_rule: Reported for every tier whatever the outcome: our number against Qwen-2.5-Omni-7B (tier 3 50.2, tier 4 22.4, tier 6 68.3, tier 7 48.2) and against the weakest published SpeechLM row (tier 3 40.6, tier 4 7.9, tier 6 44.6, tier 7 34.5). A tier below a degraded model's published number is called out explicitly.
decision.power_note: n = 500 per tier gives a binomial standard error of 1.9 pp at p = 0.75, 2.1 pp at p = 0.33, 1.7 pp at p = 0.82 and 2.2 pp at p = 0.55, so the 3 pp band is wider than the noise on all four tiers and ALIGNED is a meaningful outcome rather than an artefact of a small sample. The frozen 400's n = 50 gave 6-7 pp, which is why none of these four tiers was decided there even though all four fell inside the band.
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is discovery data; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no mechanism arm, no Q8_0 flight (that is its own preregistered probe), no training-free policy fit, no edit to the locked SLURP cell, and no re-flight of tiers 1, 2, 5 or 8.

why_one_run_id: All four tiers fly in ONE roster, ONE split identity hash and ONE run id because they are one population draw with tier as the stratum. contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's; a single roster satisfies that, exactly as the tiers-2/5/8 flight did.
